placement: Immediately after EarkSIPGenerator; success relationship routes to Add event.groovy.
purpose: Stages event.* and agent.* attributes so Add event.groovy emits an 'information package creation' NDJSON record describing the E-ARK SIP that EarkSIPGenerator just produced. This is a separate event from 'creation' (the Scanity digitization, staged earlier by 04_Extract creation event from METS.groovy) — it runs much later in the flow, after EarkSIPGenerator, and is its own trip to Add event.groovy.

properties.event.detail: Opprettet SIP i henhold til Nasjonalbibliotekets profil SIP 1.0.
properties.agent.name: nifi-nb-eark-nar.EarkSIPGenerator
properties.agent.note: Apache NiFi-prosessor utviklet av Nasjonalbiblioteket for opprettelse av E-ARK SIP. Bruker commons-ip, et Java-bibliotek for opprettelse og håndtering av E-ARK-informasjonspakker.

notes: All four agent.* properties are required because agent.name is set — the Apache NiFi defaults in Add event.groovy only apply when agent.name is unset.

agent.version (1.0.11) is the deployed nifi-nb-eark-nar NAR version. The DPS team documents what the EarkSIPGenerator agent consists of, so we no longer track the bundled commons-ip version separately. Bump this when a new EarkSIPGenerator NAR is deployed (e.g. the MDOTHERTYPE fix).

event.datetime is captured with now() at this processor, which runs immediately after EarkSIPGenerator — i.e. the actual SIP-creation time. Each event records its own real timestamp so the DPS shows them in correct chronological order; the previous shared #{timestamp} parameter gave transfer and this event identical/wrong times.
